capabilities: Edit translations, notes, and suggestions in place
Look up French words and translate selections
Run read-only AI interpretation via CLI
disambiguation: Not just a translation aid; it is a reading, editing, and library-sync environment built specifically around Lacan seminar translations.
extras: Desktop-only (manifest isDesktopOnly: true, requires Obsidian 1.8.0+); UI and reading materials are mainly in Chinese. 'Local Agent' means a local CLI process, not necessarily local model inference; text sent to the CLI may leave the machine. No telemetry. Scanned PDFs need an OCR text layer from another tool. Detailed CLI-adaptation and architecture docs are referenced but kept elsewhere.
problem: Reading and translating Lacan seminars requires segment-level bilingual comparison, notes, and translation aids that Obsidian does not provide on its own.
